title: wk-rebase-abort
desc: Guard-exempt WillKim recovery tool that safely aborts an in-progress git rebase, for recovering a repo left stuck mid-rebase by a lost-race wkpush
steps: WHAT: Safely aborts an in-progress git rebase from an AI session. It wraps git rebase --abort -- which the concurrent-guard blocks with no override -- inside a guard-exempt WillKim tool, to recover a repo left stuck mid-rebase by a lost-race wkpush.

USAGE: Run bare wk-rebase-abort with optional -Repo path. It detects rebase-merge or rebase-apply state and aborts if present, restoring ORIG_HEAD plus autostash, and is a no-op otherwise. Commits made DURING the rebase become dangling and must be re-committed afterward from a clean tree.
SEE ALSO: wkpush-git-push-race-winner step 10 is the mid-rebase bug this recovers from. wkharness-guards documents the concurrent-guard this tool legitimately encapsulates.
author: claude
